subject: Prompt/Response Rights, Subprocessor Routing & Evidence Request — BrightBridge DPA
messages:
From: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@brightbridge.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightbridge.com
Date: 2026-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: DPA questions — prompt/response ownership, subprocessors, evidence pack

Connor,

Thanks for taking this on. A few items our legal and procurement teams need clarified before we can move the DPA forward:  

1) Model improvement opt-outs: the DPA redlines ask that BrightBridge customer interactions are excluded from model improvement unless explicitly opted into. Please confirm how Redwood implements opt-outs operationally and whether you can provide a formal attestation.

2) Prompt/Response IP: we want to confirm that prompts and generated responses are treated as our customer data and that derivative rights wording is limited. Can you confirm custody and licensing for prompt/response pairs?

3) Subprocessors & cross-border routing: we need a current list of subprocessors and a clear statement on any cross-border transfers (esp. US<>EU). If you rely on marketplace or cloud partners, we need details/controls for routing (onshore KMS, residency options).

4) Evidence & onboarding: procurement is requesting an evidence pack (logs, attestation of non-improvement for excluded datasets, sftp/dropbox transfer options) and a short timeline for delivery. We attached our DPA redlines (see attachment).

Can we schedule a 30-minute call this week to walk through and identify the quickest path to satisfy procurement?

Thanks,

Alyssa Park
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Security
BrightBridge Health

Attachment: DPA_redlines_v1.pdf

From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-23T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA questions — prompt/response ownership, subprocessors, evidence pack

Alyssa — thanks for the clear list. Looping Marissa (sales lead) and David (privacy ops) so we can answer operational and procurement asks. Quick summary up front:  

- Model improvement opt-out: BrightBridge interactions can be excluded by default for your account. We provide a written attestation and an operations proof bundle showing the exclusion flag and audit logs. Exclusion is enforced at the request-routing layer and the serving runtime — i.e., excluded requests bypass telemetry collection used for model updates.  

- Prompt/response rights: Redwood’s default hosted terms grant customers ownership/custody of prompts + responses for their tenant data; derivatives for platform improvement are explicitly excluded when the opt-out flag is set. We’ll provide the clause references and a short mapping doc.

- Subprocessors & routing: we maintain a live subprocessors list (GCP, S3, CDN, and a few regional monitoring partners). For BrightBridge we can configure onshore routing for EU/US residency requests and customer-managed KMS for the Dedicated/Private options.

Next steps I propose:  
1) We’ll prepare an evidence pack (attestation, redacted logs, subprocessors list, dataflow diagram) and upload to the secure evidence folder.  
2) David — can you prepare the attestation template and confirm whether SFTP or share-to-GDrive is preferred for BrightBridge?
3) Marissa — I’ll follow up on timeline and any commercial changes (e.g., if BrightBridge needs Dedicated capacity to satisfy residency/KMS requirements).

I’m available for a call Thu 10–12 or Fri 14–16 PT. What works for you?

—Connor
Connor Obrien
Enterprise Solutions (Sales)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-dpa-summary.pdf

From: procurement@brightbridge.com
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-24T08:31:00-07:00
Subject: RE: DPA questions — procurement follow-up and timeline

Team — thanks, that summary helps. A few clarifications from procurement/legal:  

• Attestation: we need a signed attestation (DocuSign) that BrightBridge-designated datasets will not be used for model training or improvement unless BrightBridge provides explicit written opt-in. The attestation should include the mechanism (routing flag, tenant exclude) and a statement on audit logs retention.

• Evidence transfer: procurement prefers SFTP to a BrightBridge-managed bucket for the evidence pack. Please confirm SFTP host details, credentials process, and whether package encryption (PGP) is supported.

• KMS & marketplace: BrightBridge is evaluating GCP Marketplace procurement. If Redwood relies on marketplace billing or marketplace-hosted images, we need a statement whether that affects subprocessor/residency commitments.

Attached is our standard procurement form with required fields (budget code, PO terms). If you can provide the attestation and SFTP details by EOD Tue (2026-05-26) that would keep us on schedule for a June 1 contract execution.

Thanks — procurement@brightbridge.com

Attachment: procurement_form.xlsx

From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@brightbridge.com, Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-25T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA questions — procurement follow-up and timeline

Got it — we’ll action the EOD Tue ask. Quick delivery plan:  

1) David will draft the attestation and export a redacted audit log sample showing the exclusion flag and request routing metadata. Expect delivery by 2026-05-26 17:00 PT.  
2) Infra will provision an SFTP transfer. Connor (me) will send host/PGP instructions; we can also provide a signed S3 presigned URL if BrightBridge prefers.
3) I’ll confirm whether any Marketplace billing routes affect subprocessors — high-level: billing via marketplace does not change dataflow or subprocessors; we will provide a short statement to that effect for procurement.

Action items:  
- David Kim: prepare attestation + logs (JIRA SUP-4321).  
- Marissa Cole: prepare note on Dedicated capacity options and any implications for SLA/KMS.  
- Connor: send SFTP/PGP details and DocuSign link for attestation.

I’ll upload the redwood evidence pack to the secure folder and post the link here once it’s ready. If you’d like to move faster, I can book a short handoff call tomorrow afternoon.

—Connor
Connor Obrien
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
